tvShow.name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
tvShow.originalName: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
tvShow.overview: Merlin, the immortal son of the bard Taliesin and Atlantean Princess Charis, is followed through his tragic upbringing, descent into madness, and shocking disappearance, leading to the legend that surrounds him. Set before King Arthur's birth, Merlin, assumed dead or a myth, reemerges in sub-Roman Britain to unite the fractured kingdoms under threat from Saxon invaders.

episodes.name: Production Diary 1: The Start of an Epic Adventure
episodes.overview: Behind the scenes of week 1 of production on The Pendragon Cycle. Get a glimpse into the rigorous training, stunts, and more during the filming in Hungary.

episodes.name: Production Diary 2: The Week of Battles
episodes.overview: Behind the scenes of week 2 of production on The Pendragon Cycle. Immerse yourself in the epic battle scenes filled with blood, iron, mayhem and more.

episodes.name: Production Diary 3: Meet the Show’s Villain
episodes.overview: Behind the scenes during week 3 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Meet Morgian, Charis' intriguing step-sister, and see the first scenes filmed at the home of the Atlanteans.

episodes.name: Production Diary 4: A Love Story
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 4 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Embark on a journey alongside the cast and crew as they utilize a Hungarian forest for the mesmerizing backdrop of Myrddin and Ganieda’s meeting and more.

episodes.name: Production Diary 7: Recreating Wales in Italy
episodes.overview: Behind-the-scenes during week 7 of the production of The Pendragon Cycle. Join the cast and crew as they face the challenges and triumphs of filming amidst hurricane winds, harsh weather, and the stunning landscapes of Italy.

episodes.name: Island of the Mighty
episodes.overview: The age of gods is dying, and the tribes of Britain descend into chaos. One man hears a voice that will change history.

episodes.overview: A forbidden union gives birth to a prophecy that will outlive the world that made it.

reviews.author: Eldho_Tomy
reviews.content:
I really enjoyed this show. It offers a refreshing take on Arthurian legends by focusing on Merlin’s origins instead of the usual King Arthur storyline. The show does a great job blending mythology, history, and fantasy, creating a world that feels both mystical and grounded.

The atmosphere and locations give the series a strong historical fantasy feel, and the story slowly builds Merlin’s journey in an interesting way. Even though the pacing can feel a little rushed at times, the overall narrative and lore make it very engaging.

If you enjoy fantasy series with deep mythology and a darker tone, this show is definitely worth watching. I’m really hoping it gets another season because the story feels like it has much more to explore.
